# x402-app-template

Use this template to build your own x402-gated MCP service in the same shape as MangroveTrader and the Mangrove KB server. It bundles every piece you need to ship: dual-protocol (REST + MCP) on one FastAPI app, three-tier access (free / auth / x402), Terraform IaC for GCP Cloud Run, GitHub Actions with OIDC, Docker build, local dev with `docker compose`.

GitHub: [`x402-app-template`](https://github.com/MangroveTechnologies/x402-app-template) (public template repo).

## Quickstart

```bash
# Clone or use as a GitHub template
gh repo create my-service --template MangroveTechnologies/x402-app-template --public
cd my-service

# Local config
cp src/config/local-example-config.json src/config/local-config.json
# edit local-config.json: set wallet, network (base / base-sepolia), tool prices

# Run locally
docker compose up -d --build
curl http://localhost:8080/health
```

The template ships with a few example tools so you can verify x402 end-to-end on Base Sepolia before customizing.

## Tech stack

| Layer | Choice |
|---|---|
| Web framework | FastAPI + uvicorn |
| Agent protocol | FastMCP (Streamable HTTP) |
| Payments | [`x402`](https://pypi.org/project/x402/) Python SDK |
| Database (optional) | PostgreSQL 16 |
| Cache (optional) | Redis 7 |
| IaC | Terraform (GCP Cloud Run) |
| CI/CD | GitHub Actions with OIDC (no long-lived secrets) |

## Three-tier access model

Every endpoint declares its tier in code; the framework enforces the rule.

| Tier | No credentials | API key | x402 payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| **Auth-gated** | 401 | ✓ | 401 |
| **x402-gated** | 402 (payment required) | ✓ (free for tier holders) | ✓ (paid) |

In code:

```python
from src.framework import tool, Access

@tool(name="my_free_tool", access=Access.FREE)
async def my_free_tool(): ...

@tool(name="my_premium_tool", access=Access.X402, price_usdc=0.10, network="base")
async def my_premium_tool(): ...
```

The `@tool` decorator publishes to both REST (`/api/v1/tools/my_premium_tool`) and MCP (`my_premium_tool`) automatically.

## Real-world example

[MangroveTrader](https://github.com/MangroveTechnologies/MangroveTrader) is built directly from this template. Look at it for a reference implementation that includes a Twitter agent worker, x402 settlement, and a public leaderboard.

## What you customize

1. `src/config/` — wallet address, network, x402 facilitator URL, tool pricing
2. `src/tools/` — add your `@tool`-decorated functions
3. `terraform/` — set the GCP project ID, service name, and Cloud Run config
4. `.github/workflows/` — wire your repo to your GCP project (OIDC, no secrets)

## What you don't have to build

- MCP `tools/list` and tool dispatch (handled)
- REST bridge auto-generation (handled)
- x402 facilitation: 402 response, payment header validation, settlement (handled)
- Cloud Run deploy with rollout, health checks, traffic management (handled)
- Local-vs-prod config split (handled)
